name: Frozen external January 2026 evaluation
selection: All original 30 training-selected stations; all 744 hours; no reselection by new activity or outcome
training: Existing fitted pipelines trained/refitted on Jan-Oct 2025; no fit, tuning, recalibration or model selection on new data
initial_history: Final 168 hours of original recorded-count panel; January rolling one-step features use only preceding known completed-ride counts
boundary: Include deduplicated December-origin cleaned trips arriving after January start; clean January selected-endpoint records with original rules; count endpoints independently in local-January window
uncertainty: Paired local-day differences of MAE, 1000 bootstrap resamples seed2025; full-period and fixed weekday/weekend/peak strata
retention: Retain all model outcomes, including unfavorable cross-year shifts; do not replace old baseline or retune
scope: First evaluation of this new archived month in this project; public protocol frozen in Git before downloading target records, not a claim of formal trial preregistration or prospective online deployment
